item.title: Americans react to U.S. strikes on Iran
item.description: Americans across the political spectrum are reacting to the U.S.-Israeli strikes against Iran. CBS News' Lana Zak has more.

item.title: Woman and dog killed, 3 others stabbed in road rage incident on D.C. beltway
item.description: Virginia State Police were called to Interstate 495 southbound near exit 52 in Annandale, Virginia, around 1:20 p.m. on Sunday for a reported road rage incident.

item.title: Satellite images show Iranian sites before and after airstrikes
item.description: The satellite images show damage to sites including the Choqa Balk-e drone facility and former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's compound​.

item.title: Photo shows slain Texas gunman with Iranian symbol on his T-shirt
item.description: The gunman who killed 3 and wounded 13 at a bar in Austin also wore a hoodie that said "Property of Allah."

item.title: 2/23: Face the Nation
item.description: This week on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan," the president's mission to shrink the federal workforce intensifies, and his foreign policy dealmaking reaches a critical juncture. We'll speak with President Trump's Middle East envoy Steve Witkoff, Gov. Kathy Hochul of New York and more.

item.title: 3/2: CBS Evening News
item.description: Trump says U.S. will "easily prevail" as Iran fights back; House panel releases video of Clintons' Epstein testimony.

item.title: 3/2: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: The latest details on Day 3 of war with Iran; video released of the Clintons' depositions on Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Military officials question fortifications at site where U.S. troops were killed
item.description: The first American service members to die in the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran were killed in an apparent Iranian drone attack on a makeshift office space in Kuwait, sources told CBS News.

item.title: U.S. death toll in Iran war rises to 6 as Trump warns of long campaign
item.description: The U.S. military said Monday that the number of Americans killed during the ongoing conflict with Iran now stands at six. Follow live updates on Day 3 of the war.

item.title: Fatal First Date
item.description: A couple’s first date ends with an ambush. Both are shot. Can the only survivor identify the shooter? "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.
